name: devfactory
description: Carries a change from a card to an accepted unattended build: the request as a card that meets a Definition of Request, a specification that earns a Definition of Ready, a parent issue run as one session per sub-issue, and a Definition of Done, configured per project by a project profile, with Python scripts for its machine checks, four hooks that enforce its rules, and events at each hand-off that a project hooks to move its own cards.
